name: East International, runway 09/27
summary: The crossing runway of the test field's east airport. Landed on eastward (09) from its western threshold. A final into 27 would begin 37 km out, past the wire's edge, so 27 is for take-offs only.

sources.length_m: As Cape International's: the 747-400 at its maximum weight on a hot day, Boeing D6-58326-1 rev F 3.3.4, rounded up to 3,500 m.
sources.width_m: FAA AC 150/5300-13B change 1, table G-11 (C/D/E-V): 150 ft.
sources.protection: The same table as Cape International's, approach visibility below 3/4 mile; the test field's ground also keeps a 34:1 funnel clear 10 NM off each end (Airfield.pads_for).
sources.unusable_end: 27 (this file's threshold, the east end) takes no final: 10 NM out from it is x 36.6 km, past the wire's +-32.8 km. A runway laid across the map cannot take a final from outside it; lane/testfield step 0.
